main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

subsection.content: That the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2016 (Public Law 114-53) is amended by striking the date specified in section 106(3) and inserting “December 16, 2015”.

section.continuation: This Act may be cited as the “Further Continuing Appropriations Act, 2016”.
